upstream.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)

classification.analysis: Open WebUI is a massively popular, self-hosted, extensible AI interface that sits in front of Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible API, giving individuals and enterprises a ChatGPT-like frontend with built-in RAG (9 vector DB backends), web search, image generation, voice/video calls, persistent memory, calendars/automations, and pluggable Filters/Actions/Pipes/Tools/Skills including MCP and OpenAPI tool servers. Built with a Python/FastAPI backend and Svelte frontend, it supports enterprise features like RBAC, SSO/SCIM, OpenTelemetry observability, and horizontal scaling with Redis, and anchors a wider ecosystem (Open WebUI Computer, Open Terminal, oikb, desktop app). It's aimed at anyone who wants full control over their AI stack — from a single-user Docker deployment to enterprise-scale self-hosted LLM infrastructure — without depending on a hosted SaaS chat product.

use_cases.title: Stand up a self-hosted ChatGPT-style interface in front of local Ollama models
Give a team RAG over internal documents with hybrid search and reranking
Wrap a base model with custom tools and instructions to build a specialized in-house agent
Deploy an enterprise AI platform with SSO, RBAC, and OpenTelemetry observability
